source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
In your Shooting phase, once this unit has finished shooting, pick 1 enemy unit that at least 1 of this unit's accelerator autocannon attacks hit. That enemy unit becomes suppressed:

- it stays suppressed until your next turn starts, and only while this unit remains on the battlefield
- attacks by models in a suppressed unit get -1 to their **Hit rolls**

select.hitBy: accelerator autocannon attacks of this unit

ability.duration: until your next turn begins, as long as this unit is still on the battlefield

lastPrinted.note: Build 972, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Suppressor Squad datasheet; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
